response.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(1.0 * derived_total_cost / NULLIF(derived_product_cost, 0)) AS avg_total_to_product_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The ratio is computed per line item (derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost) and then averaged across each invoice's line items. Line items with a NULL or zero derived_product_cost have no defined ratio, so NULLIF excludes them from the average. They still count toward line_item_count.
Invoices are taken from Invoice_Line_Items, so an invoice with no line items never appears. It could not rank in the top 10 by line count anyway.
Invoices with equal line-item counts are ordered by invoice_number ascending. The request does not specify a tie-breaker.
